function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH aug AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel,
    SUM(sl.qty) AS qty,
    SUM(sl.revenue_cad) AS rev,
    SUM(sl.revenue_cad - (sl.qty * pa.po_amount_cad / NULLIF(pa.po_qty,0))) AS gm
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS po_qty, SUM(amount_cad) AS po_amount_cad
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
    WHERE period = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY period, sku
  ) pa ON sl.sku = pa.sku AND sl.period = pa.period
  WHERE sl.period = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY c.channel
),
sep AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(sl.qty) AS total_qty
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  WHERE sl.period = '2026-09'
),
sep_share AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel,
    SUM(sl.qty) AS qty,
    SUM(sl.qty) / FIRST(sep.total_qty) AS share
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN sep
  WHERE sl.period = '2026-09'
  GROUP BY c.channel
)
SELECT
  aug.channel,
  aug.qty AS aug_qty,
  aug.gm AS aug_gm,
  aug.gm / NULLIF(aug.qty,0) AS aug_unit_margin,
  sep_share.qty AS sep_qty,
  sep_share.share AS sep_share,
  aug.qty / (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM aug) AS aug_share,
  (sep_share.share - aug.qty / (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM aug)) * aug.gm / NULLIF(aug.qty,0) * (SELECT total_qty FROM sep) AS mix_effect_channel
FROM aug
JOIN sep_share ON aug.channel = sep_share.channel
ORDER BY aug.channel","purpose":"Compute mix effect per channel"}
